body:
Good catch! Apparently, when cookies are disabled accessing `window.sessionStorage` is an error, so [ScrollService][1] throws.

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/aio/src/app/shared/scroll.service.ts
@ajitsinghkaler, would you like to take this on? This is a fairly straight forward issue and I would be happy to guide/help you through the process.
I would love to thank you for helping me get started.

issue.body:
fix(docs-infra): changed window.sessionStorage to default params when cookies disabled

Whenever cookies are disabled windows.sessionStorage is not available for the app so If it throws an error I give it a default value
